font_size_scale.h1_hero: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl tracking-tight font-serif font-light
font_size_scale.caption: text-xs tracking-widest uppercase font-sans text-neutral-500

component_strategy.public_gallery: Custom HTML + Tailwind CSS + Framer Motion for smooth transitions, masonry layout grid, slideshow slider, and fullscreen lightbox modal with direct backend attachment stream download.
component_strategy.admin_dashboard: Shadcn/UI components (Table, Dialog, Tabs, Switch, Input, Select, Button, Toast/Sonner) customized with high-contrast warm neutrals and crisp 1px borders.

public_client_gallery.header_branding: Dynamic client logo or styled typography, client title & subtitle/date, background color overlay override option
public_client_gallery.download_feature: Per-photo download button calling backend endpoint `/api/galleries/:slug/photos/:id/download` with Content-Disposition: attachment header. Subject to toggle download on/off set in admin.
public_client_gallery.photo_loading: Progressive blurred skeleton placeholder -> high quality photo. Lazy-loading enabled.
public_client_gallery.lightbox: Fullscreen view with next/prev navigation, zoom toggle, photo caption, image metadata, and quick download button.

capabilities: Manage client galleries (Create, Edit, Delete, Slug copy)
Upload photos with multi-file drag and drop
Reorder photos (drag or sequence number input)
Configure client branding (Logo URL, Primary color, Font style, Title, Description, Date)
Configure Gallery layout preset (Grid, Masonry, Slideshow, Fullscreen)
Toggle per-photo download button ON / OFF
Live interactive preview panel showing client view in real-time

testing_and_accessibility.data_testid_policy: Mandatory data-testid on all interactive buttons, inputs, links, tabs, layout toggles, download buttons, and modal elements.

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure backend stream download endpoint sets correct Content-Disposition: attachment; filename=... header.
Use sonner for user toasts during photo uploads, settings save, and download start notifications.
Ensure demo gallery with sample wedding photos is available immediately on first load.
